name: Transcendent Group AB (publ)
summary: Transcendent Group AB (publ) engages in the management consulting business in Sweden and internationally. Its services include compliance, corporate governance, digital governance, information security, IT audit, internal audit, privacy, and financial risk. The company serves clients in the public and private sectors, including government agencies, businesses, and other organizations in a variety of industries. Transcendent Group AB (publ) was founded in 2001 and is based in Stockholm, Sweden.
